proved_step: statement: For matrices A and B over a field with rank(A) <= r and rank(B) <= s, the entrywise product A∘B has rank at most rs. Indeed, write A=UV^T and B=XY^T with r and s columns respectively. Then (A∘B)_{ij}=sum_{a=1}^r sum_{c=1}^s (U_{ia}X_{ic})(V_{ja}Y_{jc}), an explicit sum of at most rs rank-one matrices; hence rank(A∘B)<=rs.

statement: Let f and g be functions on X_1×⋯×X_n with tensor-train representations over a field, with bond dimensions (r_0=1,r_1,…,r_{n-1},r_n=1) and (s_0=1,s_1,…,s_{n-1},s_n=1). Their pointwise product fg has a tensor-train representation with bond dimensions at most (r_0s_0,…,r_ns_n), hence at most r_i s_i across cut i. Construct the i-th core by G'_i[(a,c),x_i,(b,d)] = G_i[a,x_i,b]H_i[c,x_i,d]; contraction factors into the two original contractions.
